predictor.notes: Used 24 business requests and 8 REA operations, including inspection. The approved workflow returned exact prices of 98,594 cents at quantity 50 and 131,005 cents at quantity 200. All other observed responses reported roundingCents=100000, including the alternate workflow in session 2. Assuming nearest-100,000-cent rounding and locally monotone prices, observations bracket the 150,000-cent crossing between quantities 232 and 238, the 250,000-cent crossing between 432 and 438, and the 350,000-cent crossing between 832 and 838. This continuous piecewise-linear predictor interpolates the two exact observations, places those crossings at bracket midpoints, and is consistent with every observed rounded response. Segment starts are modeling choices, not verified pricing-band boundaries. Exact behavior is not uniquely identifiable from these observations; curvature, discontinuities, and unobserved variation remain uncertain, especially below quantity 50 and above quantity 838.
